integrity: The all-order proof is symbolic. Finite symbolic checks were used only as sanity checks and not as evidence for the infinite statement. Supporting older literature is distinguished from the recent focal source.
scientific_limitations: The proof is Euclidean and Frobenius-specific. It does not address tensor spectral interpretations, other symmetry groups, or hyperbolic analogues. An equivalent older isotropic-tensor derivation under different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: A Lyons–Zumbrun axis-counting proof of the higher-order radial Frobenius formula
